description: Sealed frame parser: a header guarded by a magic, a Fletcher-16 checksum and a version, then typed extensions; the name extension's length is checked against the wrong bound

bugs.trigger: sdf_parse on a frame with a valid header (magic SDF1, Fletcher-16 of the first 10 bytes in bytes 10-11, version 2, 1..8 extensions) whose name extension (type 1) is 9..32 bytes long: ext_name checks the length against SDF_NAME_MAX (32) and copies it into an 8-byte stack buffer

lexer_expected: Control case for step I6, not a lexer weakness: modules and entry points are right for both Phase 0s. The checksum is compared through an XOR with zero, so libFuzzer's compare tables cannot repair it, and a header with a valid checksum, version and extension count is out of reach of a short campaign from an empty corpus. The unit tests (tests/test_sdf.c, `./sdf_test`) parse sealed frames with short names: a seed recorded from them needs one length byte changed to reach the bug.
